title: Smoky Russian Pilaf
description: A hearty and flavorful pilaf dish inspired by Russian cuisine, featuring smoky notes from the bacon and a perfect balance of spices.
instructions: Cook the bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy. Remove the bacon from the skillet and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the smoked paprika and thyme to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pilaf to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the skillet, and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the pilaf hot, topped with the crispy bacon.
